title: Motion and glow budget reverted
notes: Reverts issue #5014's motion and glow budget (v0.6.15b) and its follow-up from issue #5091: card faces loop their decoration again (keyword treatments, the Mythic hand shimmer, the zzz, the Dormant seal and shipyard idle, marks, Glitch, the animated rarity foil, the full-screen view's camera), and the title screen's gold wordmark, hearth and embers are back; no card plays differently.
